Benguet Learners

By Manila Standard Business
October 15, 2026, 8:20 PM
Share
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
WhatsApp
    16px
    Estimated reading time: 15 seconds
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by

    Instaread

    About 96 learners at Piminggan Elementary School in Tuba, Benguet now experience more engaging lessons through digital presentations, educational videos and interactive activities made possible by AuroraPH of Aboitiz Foundation. Located 43 kilometers from Baguio City, Piminggan Elementary School had long struggled with limited access to electricity.
